GOV-F-003-S62.title: Expired Lock Detection and Cleanup
GOV-F-003-S62.description: Implement logic to detect expired locks based on expires_at and automatically mark them as available. Ensure cleanup occurs during acquisition attempts and optionally via periodic scan to prevent stale lock buildup.

GOV-F-003-S63.title: Lock Recovery and Reassignment Logic
GOV-F-003-S63.description: Implement recovery logic to safely reassign locks when the original owner fails (e.g., crash or timeout). Ensure ownership validation and idempotent reassignment to prevent duplicate execution of assignments.

GOV-F-003-S64.title: Brain Lock Concurrency and Failure Tests
GOV-F-003-S64.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering concurrent lock acquisition, TTL expiration, renewal races, and recovery scenarios. Validate atomicity and ensure no duplicate assignment execution occurs under contention.
